events.title: Google Glass ecosystem enters the Explorer era
events.summary: Google Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz and Kleiner Perkins formed the Glass Collective to fund applications for Google Glass, documenting the emergence of a commercial developer ecosystem around wearable display computing.

events.title: Snap announces Spectacles and becomes Snap Inc.
events.summary: Snap introduced Spectacles as a hardware product alongside Snapchat and renamed the company Snap Inc., beginning one of the longest-running consumer smart-glasses product lines.

events.title: Google launches Glass Enterprise Edition 2
events.summary: Google introduced Glass Enterprise Edition 2 on Qualcomm Snapdragon XR1, Android and USB-C, formalizing Glass as an enterprise wearable-computing platform.

events.title: Ray-Ban Stories launches
events.summary: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launched Ray-Ban Stories, putting cameras and open-ear audio into a conventional Ray-Ban frame and establishing a major consumer smart-glasses line.

events.title: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses announced
events.summary: Meta announced the next generation of Ray-Ban smart glasses with improved capture, audio, livestreaming and Meta AI integration, shifting the line toward everyday AI assistance.

events.title: Even Realities launches G1
events.summary: Even Realities introduced the G1, a camera-free binocular waveguide product focused on discreet text, navigation, teleprompter and translation rather than immersive AR.

events.title: Snap introduces fifth-generation Spectacles and Snap OS
events.summary: Snap introduced standalone see-through AR Spectacles powered by Snap OS and distributed them through a paid developer program.

events.title: XREAL One brings spatial processing onto the glasses
events.summary: XREAL's One generation centered spatial-display functions on its in-house X1 chip, moving more spatial processing from companion accessories into the glasses themselves.

events.title: Google announces Android XR
events.summary: Google announced Android XR with Samsung and Qualcomm as a common Android platform for next-generation headsets and glasses, with Gemini integrated into the platform strategy.

events.title: Rokid launches display-equipped Rokid Glasses globally
events.summary: Rokid launched 49 g AI/AR glasses combining a dual-eye MicroLED waveguide display, 12 MP camera, Snapdragon AR1 platform, open-ear audio and real-time translation.

events.title: Meta launches Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 and introduces Meta Ray-Ban Display
events.summary: Meta expanded its consumer eyewear line with longer-runtime Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 while introducing Meta Ray-Ban Display and the EMG-based Meta Neural Band, bringing an in-lens display to the Ray-Ban Meta family.

events.title: Snap OS 2.0 expands Spectacles toward general-purpose computing
events.summary: Snap OS 2.0 added a redesigned browser, home-screen widgets and other utilities while Snap prepared its glasses platform for broader public availability.
